title: All the people. Welcome home, Stephen! Noises of welcome. His mother kissed him. Was that right?
html_source: Stephen questions whether his mom should kiss him because, back at boarding school, that was one of the many things the boys would say to tease him. Stephen is so happy to be home that the idea is merely a fleeting thought in his mind.
